On VTES-L, "....salem...." wrote:
> does "stake" (jyhad) count as the same card as "wooden
> stake" (VTES)?

Yes. [according to the article by Tom Wylie and Paul
Peterson "FROM JYHAD TO VAMPIRE: THE ETERNAL STRUGGLE" in
the Duelist, posted to the Newsgroup on 24-NOV-1995]

> ie: wooden stake's errata is stake's errata also?

Yes. [LSJ 24-MAR-1999]:

* Stake is removed from the Banned list. (Since it was
renamed "Wooden Stake" it follows all card text and
errata for the Wooden Stake).
